record.title: Bulgarian grain-grower road blocks at Ruse, Kardam and Vidin, March 2023
record.scope: Three named international road approaches, not the entire Romania frontier
record.crossings: Ruse / Giurgiu; Kardam / Negru Voda; Vidin / Calafat
record.direction: Scope is phase-specific; symmetric direction detail is incomplete
record.movement: Road vehicles on the named approaches
record.exceptions: No general pedestrian, emergency or cargo exemption inventory is supplied. Port actions are excluded.

record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No March 29 2023 Bulgarian farmer crossing episode in the full Register/phase inventory or current/pending union. REC50-R42 L01 and L02 share one parent. R16-EU-002 is Siret, Romania–Ukraine, on April 7, a different frontier/action.

record.current_corrections: Three named road approaches are retained within one March 29 campaign. Port actions at Silistra/Vidin are not land-crossing phases. Plans for subsequent days or April 7 are not observed extensions.
